messages.subject: Quartz — diligence scope
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Data room opens today. Please take first pass on corporate, commercial contracts and property. I'm flagging two things to watch: (1) the Wexbourne Retail supply agreement is ~18% of revenue and we suspect a change-of-control clause; (2) the Warrington lease has a 2026 tenant break. Marlow Tax are doing FDD/TDD. Let's aim to have a draft report by 12 Feb.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Quartz — diligence scope
messages.plaintextBody:
James — confirmed on both. The Wexbourne agreement (1 May 2023) does have a change-of-control termination right on 60 days' notice. Lease break is June 2026, and there's an outstanding rent review. There's also a Clydesford Bank debenture over the assets we'll need released at completion. Trade mark 'VelloSan' is registered in the UK; EU application pending. Writing it all up.

Elena
